sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the verified direct-static requirement: angle applicability is enforced with positive gamma below 80 degrees and beta above 10 degrees, while the fixed AR=3.6 and Pavg, nonBowLoadPatchHeight, and nonBowLoadPatchLength constraints are conditional on the controlled other-ice-strengthened-area assignment. Owners, relationship paths, datatypes, units, and controlled alternatives are consistent, and deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedAngleQuantity_I2_009, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedAspectRatioQuantity_I2_009, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedHullAreaAssignmentShape_I2_009, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedLengthQuantity_I2_009, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedPressureQuantity_I2_009, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedShape_I2_009
Semantic validator feedback: Replace the six unknown nltl:Generated* IRIs with blank-node SHACL shapes (or non-vocabulary shape identifiers), since they are not canonical vocabulary terms. Rework the semantics before freezing: do not introduce bowFormApplicability as a convenience boolean when applicability is determined by the supplied angle inputs; encode the bow condition directly with positive gamma < 80 degrees and beta' > 10 degrees. Make the fixed AR=3.6 check and the Pavg, bNonBow, and wNonBow requirements conditional on the other-ice-strengthened-area case, rather than unconditionally requiring all operands for every ship. Remove the redundant free-text hullArea representation or replace it with the declared controlled hull-area assignment relationship, and ensure the selected hull-area value is modeled on the hullAreaAssignment node via assignedHullArea without duplicating the fact on the ship.

Repair the unit IRIs: use the QUDT vocabulary-unit namespace, not the QUDT schema namespace. Replace qudt:DEG with <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG>, qudt:MegaPA with <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA>, qudt:UNITLESS with <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS>, and qudt:M with <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M>. The conditional other-ice-strengthened-area logic, direct angle bounds, and controlled hull-area assignment otherwise preserve the prior semantic instructions.

Candidate faithfully encodes the verified direct-static requirement: angle applicability is enforced with positive gamma below 80 degrees and beta above 10 degrees, while the fixed AR=3.6 and Pavg, nonBowLoadPatchHeight, and nonBowLoadPatchLength constraints are conditional on the controlled other-ice-strengthened-area assignment. Owners, relationship paths, datatypes, units, and controlled alternatives are consistent, and deterministic validation is valid.
